name: panfolio
description: Find Panfolio recipes and kitchen techniques, follow a selected preparation, and create source-based shopping checklists using the public cookbook feed.

interface.longDescription: Look up Chinese dishes, Japanese chef recipes, desserts and kitchen references from Panfolio. Follow one selected preparation with its original quantities, explanations and source links, or build a shopping checklist. Retrieves public content on demand; requires HTTPS retrieval in the host. No Panfolio account, API key or app installation is required. Does not access personal app notes or favorites.
defaultPrompt: Use Panfolio to guide me through asparagus pork rolls.
Explain when to pour soy sauce around a hot pan using Panfolio.
Create a shopping checklist for my selected Panfolio dishes.
